Data.Description: This is our Summer Season Pass. It covers all shows, excluding Special Events, from June 1st - September 31st! ONLY ABLE TO PURCHASE AT BOX OFFICE!

For four decades, Mike Green has been making audiences laugh, sharing the stage with comedy greats, and building a reputation as one of the hardest-working comedians around. Now, after 40 years in stand-up, it's finally his turn to sit in the hot seat.
Join us for The Roast of Mike Green: Celebrating 40 Years of Comedy, a once-in-a-lifetime event honoring a comedy veteran whose career has spanned generations of laughs, friendships, and unforgettable stories.
Taking aim at Mike for this special occasion are an all-star panel of comedians and friends, including Derek Richards, Brian Belknap, Mike Bonner, Simply Shanell, Mark Hamilton, Steve Iott, Bill Bushart, Stan Moore, Nick Kelley, Bob Phillips, and Dave Dyer. Armed with decades of inside stories, sharp wit, and absolutely no mercy, they'll be delivering the kind of jokes that only longtime friends can get away with.
Expect a night packed with hilarious memories, ruthless punchlines, surprise stories, and enough laughter to celebrate 40 incredible years in comedy. It's a tribute, a reunion, and a roast all rolled into one unforgettable evening.
Whether you've followed Mike's career for years or simply love the art of a great roast, this is a comedy event you won't want to miss.
40 years. Countless laughs. One legendary roast.
Come celebrate Mike Green's remarkable career and watch as some of his closest friends spend the evening tearing it apart!

The EMMY nominated Basile has entertained millions of comedy fans in the United States, Canada, Europe, Australia, and Africa. Basile’s unique blend of material, improvisation, and characters has made him one of the most sought-after comedians in the entertainment industry today.
The multifaceted, bilingual comedian is touring Worldwide to sold-out audiences with both of his unique shows of the “BasileLicious” World Tour (general audience in English) and his critically acclaimed series of Growing Up Greek in America,” The Greek Mystique World Tour” (Greek/English speaking audiences). This comedy series is Greek themed and is spoken in both Greek and English and both show DVD’s and Downloads are distributed Worldwide and have sold millions of copies.
Basile’s voices and characters have been heard on Armed Forces Radio, Television, and Syndicated Radio as the voice of: “The God Father Of Soul, James Brown” in North America, and his comedy segments on XM/Sirius Satellite Radio. His recent Radio Show/Podcast, “A Pinch Of Basile” is now syndicated on selected radio stations in North America and throughout the world and on GreekBeatRadio.com & Grecian Echoes Radio.
Basile has over 100 television appearances throughout the world, Including: HBO, Showtime, Comedy Central, A & E, Dry Bar Comedy & the Tonight Show on NBC to name a few. Basile is also known for his voice work as Universal Studio’s Bullwinkle J. Moose, as well as for the Cartoon Network and many Japanese Anime series. Recently, Basile was recently nominated for an EMMY for his work on ESPN’s “30 for 30” series segment, “The Legend of Jimmy the Greek”, as the voice of Jimmy “The Greek” Snyder (Syionidis).

Meet the Boomer Broads – smart, sassy, and laugh-out-loud funny. With quick wit, clever stories, and just the right dose of attitude, these comedy pros prove you don’t need to be dirty to bring down the house. Age? Just material. Laughter? Guaranteed.

DUELING PIANOS IS COMING TO ONE NIGHT STAN’S! 
Get ready for a night of music, laughter, and a little friendly competition! Two talented piano players go head-to-head in an all-out musical showdown where YOU help decide the beat, the lyrics and what fun lies ahead of you!
Dirty Little Secrets is a one-of-a-kind interactive comedy show where audiences submit anonymous secrets that are read live on stage!

Join internationally known psychic medium, bestselling author, and speaker Kristy Robinett for a one of a kind afternoon that blends storytelling, comedy, comediumship, and live spirit messages.
Known for her warmth, quick wit, and down to earth style, Kristy shares the funny, heartfelt, and sometimes unbelievable moments that happen when Spirit shows up in everyday life. The afternoon also includes live gallery readings where audience members may receive messages from loved ones in Spirit. While a personal reading is not guaranteed, every guest will leave with laughter, hope, and a reminder that love never truly leaves us. Kristy Robinett has spent more than twenty years helping people find comfort, healing, and connection. She is the author of several bestselling books and has appeared on television, radio, podcasts, and stages across the country. Whether you come for the laughs, the stories, or the possibility of hearing from a loved one, Good Grief! is an afternoon you'll never forget.

Craig Shoemaker has spent over four decades proving that laughter is more than entertainment, it’s medicine. 
As a stand-up, Craig is best known for his iconic character The Lovemaster and for his comedy specials, including his Comedy Central special ranked in the Top 25 of all time. He’s earned two Emmy Awards, the American Comedy Award for “Best Male Stand-Up Comedian,” and has performed on every major network and streaming platform. He’s appeared in over 200 TV shows and films, with memorable roles on Parks and Recreation, Matlock, and even a cameo in Scream 2. 
Beyond the stage and screen, Craig has built an entirely new lane for himself as a leader in wellness and transformation. He is the founder of Laughter Worx, a corporate training company using his proprietary, non-comedic laughter techniques to shift workplace culture; creator of Laugh Bath™, an immersive laughter-healing experience now rolling out nationwide; and the visionary behind LaffApp, a wellness app blending neuroscience and humor.
He also teaches Command the Room, a masterclass and coaching platform that helps people of all backgrounds (from executives to entertainers) harness humor to elevate presence, storytelling, and connection. Whether you want to crush a keynote, win a sales pitch, or just be the funniest one at the dinner table, Craig has coached thousands on how to use laughter as their ultimate superpower. 
Craig’s career reflects his core belief: that humor is the shortest distance between two people. From Fortune 500 retreats and TED Talks to Hollywood soundstages and television and films, his mission is the same: to heal, inspire, and connect people through the transformative power of laughter.
Open Mic Night hosted by Charles Hill!

SHANG, a transplanted New Yorker whose carefully nurtured evolution from stand-up comedy to socio-political satire gives heavy flight to the spoken and outspoken word. The 2011  Famecast Comedy Winner, SHANG has been seen on CBS’S The Late Late Show 2X BET's Comic View Grand Stand Winner HBO 's Def Jam & Def Poetry, Gotham LIVE, STARZ 1st Amendment, Si TV, Mun2 Comics Unleashed, Comedy Central’s Jamie Foxx Laffapaloolza ,Premium Blend &  Gotham Comedy LIVE. Shang Also Has Guest Starred On NBC’S “Heroes”, CBS’S “CSI” & NCIS & Shang recently Co-starred for Honda their Commercial Campaign & the Movie “Devine Intervention” & “Trunked!”. Watch for him on several Upcoming international televised shows in Japan, Ireland, London and Amsterdam With over a Million Fans signed up thru his website, Shang will continue to rise to the top of the comedy ranks with high-profile acting & televised stand up & personal appearances & Self Produced 1 Hr. Comedy special  “Shang is SHANGRY! Live in NYC

Nate Armbruster is a comedian from Detroit, Michigan. He has been winning over audiences since before he had his drivers license. His quick wit, subtle humor, and laid back, charismatic, style guarantees for a great show and has earned him a spot at comedy festivals such as Gilda’s Laugh Fest and The World Series of Comedy in Las Vegas.

Scumbaggery is part talk show, part roast, part podcast and all hilarious. A surprise panel will each share and discuss something about themselves that makes them a "scumbag" in their mind. Other panelists and audience members will be given a chance to share similar stories or give advice (helpful or hilarious)

The idea is that, despite what the internet would have you believe, we're more alike than we are different. So if you steal from work or you hate one of your kids or you hate your spouse's friends come out and get it off your chest. You will laugh, but you'll also feel better after this show.

Hans is a regular on Kill Tony and has opened for Joe Rogan and Tony Hinchcliffe. Hans is also a big player on the social networking scene, where he has amassed over a hundred friends on Facebook due to his physical and emotional strength.

Carlos Mencia is a comedy powerhouse known for his fearless, no-holds-barred style and sharp takes on everyday life, culture, and the absurdities of being human. Best known as the creator and star of the hit Comedy Central series Mind of Mencia, Carlos has built a career around pushing boundaries and keeping audiences laughing.
A veteran of the comedy scene, Mencia has headlined theaters and comedy clubs across the country and has appeared in numerous television shows and films. His stand-up specials have reached millions of fans, showcasing the bold, energetic delivery that made him a household name in comedy.
From his signature social commentary to his unapologetic approach to stand-up, Carlos Mencia brings a high-energy comedy experience that is anything but predictable.

Get ready for a night of fabulous fun at our Drag Queen Game Show! ???
Our dazzling queens are bringing the party with high-energy performances, lip-syncing, dancing, singing, and hilarious interactive games that put YOU in the spotlight! Join in on the fun for your chance to win exciting prizes while enjoying delicious cocktails served all night long.
Whether you're celebrating with friends, planning a date night, or just looking for something completely different, this is one unforgettable evening packed with laughs, entertainment, and nonstop audience participation. Come ready to cheer, compete, and let loose—because you never know what these queens have planned!

An incredibly versatile and accomplished comedian working today, Lowell has emerged as a premier headliner at venues around the country. His unique blend of comedy is provocative and most importantly – real. Lowell is a native of Detroit, Michigan. After graduating from high school, he served three years in the U.S. Navy. He launched his comedy career on an open mike night at the Comedy Castle in Detroit while studying telecommunications at Eastern Michigan University. Later, he moved to Los Angeles, where he soon appeared on the hit sitcom Home Improvement and The Drew Carey Show. He made his movie debut in Walt Disney’s Jungle2Jungle and Joe Somebody. In 1997, the legendary Luther Vandross personally picked Lowell to open for his thirty cities Power of Love Tour with Vanessa Williams. Upon completing Luther's tour, George Lopez tapped Lowell to tour with him as his exclusive opening act as George's success rose to stardom from 2000 to 2004. Lowell has opened for such notables as The Temptations, Whitney Houston and many more. He appeared on Comedy Centrals’ Premium Blend  and Comics Unleashed with Byron Allen. Lowell has been working with Carnival Cruise Lines for over 25 years. He is currently touring the country with Tim Allen and regularly appears with him in Las Vegas.

Sean Shank began his comedy career in the Midwest as a house MC for Crackers Comedy Clubs, and over the years he has evolved from a set-up and punch comedian to one who has cultivated a friendly, highly interactive, storytelling-style that helps him find common ground among audiences from New York to New Mexico.
His set centers around family life, his college experiences, relationship woes and wins, growing up an isolated and poor country kid, and the things that confuse him. He gets big laughs as a headliner and feature wherever he goes by peppering his stories with quick jokes leading up to massive punches at the end!
Sean has been on CBS Stand-up Spotlight, Showtime’s Comedy on the Road, Night Shift, Starmakers, Def Jam, and he was a five-time Laughfest Pro selection. He has worked with Kevin Farley, Bobcat Goldthwait, Jeff Dunham, Carlos Mencia, Dave Attell, D.L. Hughley, Christopher Titus, Ron White, Doug Stanhope, Davin Rosenblatt, Kevin Downey Jr., Dave Landau, Robert Day, Greg Hahn, Mike Armstrong, Bob Zany, Mike Green, Larry Reeb, Mike Birbiglia, Dustin Diamond, Pauley Shore, Ralphie May, Jackie Fabulous, and many others.
Sean has a BA in English and Creative Writing and a Master’s in Writing and Teaching Writing from Johns Hopkins University and is currently working on his PhD. He has completed six novels, a multitude of articles, and an anthology of short stories. Currently he resides in Michigan and spends his days managing a comedy club, blacksmithing, and teaching writing at two colleges.

Graeson McGaha is one of the fastest-rising comedians and digital creators in America, earning a devoted national following through his relatable takes on Southern living, marriage, parenting, and blue-collar life. With millions of followers across social media and more than 1.6 million followers on TikTok, Graeson has built an audience that connects with his authentic storytelling and everyday humor.
Originally from the Southeast, Graeson first gained attention online through his viral videos about family life, millennial parenting, nostalgia, and the humorous realities of marriage. His signature "feral wife" material has become a fan favorite, resonating with audiences who appreciate his honest and hilarious perspective on relationships.
While social media accelerated his rise, Graeson's roots are firmly planted in stand-up comedy. Inspired by comedy legends such as Chris Farley, he has developed a high-energy style that blends quick wit, Southern charm, and relatable storytelling. His ability to connect with audiences from all walks of life has made him a favorite among couples, families, and blue-collar communities across the country.
Graeson currently performs nationwide, headlining clubs, theaters, and special events while also appearing on tour with Zack Rushing. His live shows feature rapid-fire stories, audience interaction, and the kind of genuine humor that leaves audiences feeling like they've spent an evening with an old friend.
When he's not on stage, Graeson travels the country with his wife, Amber, and their son, Logan, in an RV, bringing his unique brand of family-centered comedy to audiences coast to coast.
Whether online or on stage, Graeson McGaha continues to prove why he is one of the most exciting emerging voices in comedy today.

Join Kevin McDonald for an evening of "stand up" featuring stories from the legendary sketch comedy troupe - The Kids In The Hall. This show is a must-see for fans of the show! Kevin has been performing his stand up show all over North America to rave reviews. Kevin is most known for being a co-founder of The Kids In The Hall but has also appeared in many TV shows including Seinfeld and That ‘70s Show. He appeared alongside Rodney Dangerfield in the movie - The Godson. He also does voice work in animation, most notably as Agent Wendy Pleakley in the Lilo & Stitch franchise, Waffle in Catscratch, and the Almighty Tallest Purple in Invader Zim.

Brad Wenzel is a product of the Detroit comedy scene, spent a 7 year stint in Los Angeles, and over the last 15 years has toured the country performing in 38 states. Wenzel has made 3 stand-up appearances on CONAN. More recently, he performed on Netflix is a Joke Radio and Don't Tell Comedy. 
Wenzel started stand up at the age of 17 and made his first CONAN appearance while based in Michigan. His 2017 debut comedy album, Sweet Nothings, was released on Jack White’s rock label, Third Man Records, and can be heard on SiriusXM. Paste Magazine described Brad’s 2023 special, joke. joke. joke., as “Watching Wenzel feels like hanging out with your funniest, weirdest friend; it's relaxing and utterly enjoyable." Paste also listed joke. joke. joke. as one of the 20 best comedy specials of the year. Wenzel’s non-sequitur style continues the tradition of joke writers like Steven Wright, Mitch Hedberg, and Demetri Martin, while also maintaining original writing, a distinct delivery, and a sensibility of his own. On stage, Wenzel calmly sticks to his guns creatively while also possessing the ability to work on the fly due to years of experience on the road. Brad Wenzel is set to release his new special, “Desperate Times,” on April 15, 2026.

DJ Rybski is a stand-up comedian born and raised on the South Side of Chicago. A paid regular at Zanies, Laugh Factory and the Chicago Imrov, DJ has built a reputation for sharp storytelling and joke writing. He performed on the Nateland Live showcase in Nashville and was invited to the prestigious 312 Comedy Festival A-List Showcase. In 2025, he recorded a 10-minute special for OFTV.
Drawing from his unique background, including his upbringing on the South Side and his past life playing Division III collegiate baseball, DJ’s comedy has amassed over 20 million views online, where fans have coined him “the best Irish-Polish-Korean comedian in the Midwest.
Get ready for a night of laughter and outrageous fun! Our show is a club-style comedy experience featuring adult content and language — nothing vulgar or obscene, but definitely for mature audiences.
